purpose: First measurement of the central question: can small text-only LLMs write VL from a one-page reference, and does the tool's feedback let them repair their programs?

prompts.text: A wooden table with a red ball, a white ceramic mug and a stack of three books on it, in daylight.
A snowman on snowy ground: three white balls of decreasing size stacked on top of each other, a black cylinder hat on top, and two small dark spheres for eyes on the front of the head.
A room corner at night with no daylight: a sofa built from boxes, a small round side table next to it with a glass sphere on it, and one warm lamp that lights the scene.
